_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'INFORMATION SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.13.01.

f01_Regulatory_Framework_and_Applicable_.label: Regulatory Framework and Applicable Standards
f01_Regulatory_Framework_and_Applicable_.guidance: Mandatory national regulations (NCA ECC, NDMO, GDPR, ISO 27001) governing project delivery.

f02_Data_Classification_and_Privacy_Tier.label: Data Classification and Privacy Tiering
f02_Data_Classification_and_Privacy_Tier.guidance: Information classification scheme (Public, Internal, Confidential, Highly Confidential) and PII protections.

f03_Technical_and_Administrative_Securit.label: Technical and Administrative Security Controls
f03_Technical_and_Administrative_Securit.guidance: Encryption at rest/in transit, identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication, and audit trails.

f04_Security_Assessment_and_Penetration_.label: Security Assessment and Penetration Testing Cadence
f04_Security_Assessment_and_Penetration_.guidance: Vulnerability scanning, automated code analysis (SAST/DAST), and third-party penetration testing gateways.

f05_Incident_Response_Protocol_and_Breac.label: Incident Response Protocol and Breach Notification
f05_Incident_Response_Protocol_and_Breac.guidance: Escalation procedure, root cause containment, and mandatory regulatory reporting timeframes.

f06_Compliance_Audit_Gateways_and_Signof.label: Compliance Audit Gateways and Signoff Criteria
f06_Compliance_Audit_Gateways_and_Signof.guidance: Stage-gate evidence packages required by Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and legal counsel.
